title.narrative: Strengthening West African SIDS for Climate Resilience and Sustainable Development

description.narrative: This workplan aims to strengthen UNESCO’s support to Small Island Developing States (SIDS) in West Africa through enhanced vulnerability assessment, evidence-based programming, and multi-stakeholder research partnerships. It will establish a Multidimensional Vulnerability profile for Cabo Verde enabling more targeted interventions, resource mobilization, and country-level planning. The workplan will also support the implementation of the Centres of Excellence initiative in Cabo Verde and Guinea-Bissau by strengthening national coordination mechanisms, refining research priorities, and fostering partnerships to advance sustainable development and resilience in West African SIDS.
